rules.requirement: Every extension key uses a versioned absolute URI namespace.
Unknown extension values are preserved byte-for-byte in the extensions object.
Extensions cannot redefine or shadow normative fields.
A schema or semantic change requires a versioned migration fixture and compatibility classification.
Malformed, unnamespaced or conflicting extensions are rejected rather than silently interpreted.

release_boundary: This is a repository-owned bounded policy draft; it does not freeze or publish the v1 ontology.
